text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With their first clash of the fall G1 season, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap generate as much buzz as a certain past showdown between Triple Crown champions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having both risen up from anonymity, these two budding stars—and the hopes they each carry—are about to collide.
